column1: # The curated list: which places belong in the catalog.
# This is the one part of the dataset a person chose, carried over from the
# hand-authored seed this pipeline replaced. Its value was never the numbers —
# those were typed from memory and were a median 339 m out, up to 2.6 km — it
# was knowing that Chor Bazaar and Sassoon Docks belong in a catalog of Mumbai
# and that a well-mapped mid-tier restaurant does not. OSM has no signal for
# So the name and the category come from here, and everything else — the
# coordinate, the description, the locality — comes from OpenStreetMap and
# boundary.geojson. The hint coordinate is NOT used as output. It only picks
# between same-named OSM records, of which Mumbai has many.
National Centre for the Performing Arts
